title: Natural Earth Countries (1:110m)
description: World country boundaries at 1:110m scale from Natural Earth, the public domain reference basemap maintained by NACIS. Republished as cloud-native GeoParquet alongside the original zipped Shapefile.

table:columns.name: fid
table:columns.description: Feature id that GDAL assigned when the generator read the source layer. Unique in this file. It is not an upstream key.

table:columns.name: SOVEREIGNT
table:columns.description: The owning sovereign state, which differs from ADMIN for territories such as Greenland (Denmark).

table:columns.name: SOV_A3
table:columns.description: Natural Earth three-letter code of the sovereign state. Natural Earth states that the code is unique to its own coding system and somewhat follows the ISO alpha-3 codes.

table:columns.name: TYPE
table:columns.description: Unit type, Sovereign country, Country, Dependency, Disputed, Indeterminate, or Sovereignty.

table:columns.name: TLC
table:columns.description: Flag for the top-level-country (TLC) point of view. Natural Earth describes TLC as a superset of ISO. The value is 1 in 176 rows and null in one row.

table:columns.name: ADM0_A3
table:columns.description: Natural Earth's own three-letter country code. Never a sentinel value, and the join key to the populated places Collection.

table:columns.name: GEOU_DIF
table:columns.description: Flag that states if the geographic unit is different from its parent administrative unit. Natural Earth provides it so that a map does not repeat labels. The value is 0 in every row of this file.

table:columns.name: GU_A3
table:columns.description: Natural Earth three-letter code of the geographic unit. Natural Earth states that the code is unique to its own coding system and somewhat follows the ISO alpha-3 codes.

table:columns.name: SU_A3
table:columns.description: Natural Earth three-letter code of the administrative sub-unit. Natural Earth states that it is like an ISO alpha-3 code, but different.

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Short map label, for example Dem. Rep. Congo.

table:columns.name: NAME_LONG
table:columns.description: Long-form name, for example Democratic Republic of the Congo. Differs from NAME on 21 rows.

table:columns.name: NOTE_ADM0
table:columns.description: Short note that gives context to the sovereignty of the feature, such as Fr. or U.K. Null for most rows.

table:columns.name: NOTE_BRK
table:columns.description: Note that gives context to the sovereignty of a breakaway or disputed feature, such as Self admin.; Claimed by Cyprus. Null for most rows.

table:columns.name: NAME_SORT
table:columns.description: Name for sorted lists. Natural Earth provides it so that a list can ignore a prefix such as The.

table:columns.name: MAPCOLOR7
table:columns.description: Map color index. Natural Earth states that its map color derives from a US State Department political world map, where no neighboring countries have the same color and all territories of a sovereign state share one color.

table:columns.name: MAPCOLOR8
table:columns.description: Map color index. Natural Earth states that its map color derives from a US State Department political world map, where no neighboring countries have the same color and all territories of a sovereign state share one color.

table:columns.name: MAPCOLOR9
table:columns.description: Map color index. Natural Earth states that its map color derives from a US State Department political world map, where no neighboring countries have the same color and all territories of a sovereign state share one color.

table:columns.name: MAPCOLOR13
table:columns.description: Map color index. Natural Earth states that its map color derives from a US State Department political world map, where no neighboring countries have the same color and all territories of a sovereign state share one color.

table:columns.name: POP_EST
table:columns.description: Population estimate, mostly the 2019 vintage. See POP_YEAR.

table:columns.name: POP_YEAR
table:columns.description: Year the population estimate refers to.

table:columns.name: GDP_MD
table:columns.description: GDP in millions of US dollars, mostly the 2019 vintage. See GDP_YEAR.

table:columns.name: GDP_YEAR
table:columns.description: Year the GDP figure refers to.

table:columns.name: ISO_A2
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, -99 for the same five countries as ISO_A3.

table:columns.name: ISO_A2_EH
table:columns.description: ISO alpha-2 with France, Norway, and Kosovo (XK) repaired.

table:columns.name: ISO_A3
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, with the sentinel -99 for France, Norway, Kosovo, Northern Cyprus, and Somaliland. Prefer ISO_A3_EH.

table:columns.name: ISO_A3_EH
table:columns.description: ISO alpha-3 with France and Norway repaired. The column to join external ISO-coded statistics on.

table:columns.name: ADM0_ISO
table:columns.description: Country code in the ISO point of view. Natural Earth renamed it from adm0_a3_iso in version 5.1.0.

table:columns.name: ADM0_TLC
table:columns.description: Country code in the top-level-country (TLC) point of view, which Natural Earth added in version 5.1.0.

table:columns.name: CONTINENT
table:columns.description: Continent rollup. Includes the value Seven seas (open ocean), so a GROUP BY returns eight groups.

table:columns.name: REGION_UN
table:columns.description: United Nations macro region.

table:columns.name: SUBREGION
table:columns.description: United Nations subregion.

table:columns.name: MIN_ZOOM
table:columns.description: Minimum web map zoom at which to show the feature. Natural Earth optimizes it for the web Mercator projection.

table:columns.name: MIN_LABEL
table:columns.description: Minimum zoom at which to show the label. Natural Earth provides it where the label appears later than the geometry.

table:columns.name: MAX_LABEL
table:columns.description: Zoom at which the label stops.

table:columns.name: LABEL_X
table:columns.description: Longitude of the preferred label point.

table:columns.name: LABEL_Y
table:columns.description: Latitude of the preferred label point.

table:columns.name: NE_ID
table:columns.description: Stable Natural Earth feature id, unique in this file.

table:columns.name: WIKIDATAID

table:columns.name: FCLASS_ISO
table:columns.description: Feature class from the ISO point of view. Natural Earth lists the values Admin-0 country, Admin-0 dependency, Admin-1 states provinces, and Unrecognized.

table:columns.name: TLC_DIFF

table:columns.name: FCLASS_TLC
table:columns.description: Feature class from the top-level-country (TLC) point of view. This file contains Admin-0 country, Admin-0 dependency, and Unrecognized.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Country geometry, polygon or multipolygon, WGS84 longitude and latitude.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct, the GeoParquet covering used for spatial predicate pushdown.

style-continents.title: Countries by continent
style-continents.description: Each continent shares one colour from the catalog palette, including the Seven seas (open ocean) group Natural Earth assigns the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.

style-map-colors.title: Classic seven-colour map
style-map-colors.description: Natural Earth's MAPCOLOR7 index, precomputed so neighbouring countries never share a colour, the classic political-map look.

style-income-groups.title: World Bank income groups
style-income-groups.description: The INCOME_GRP ordinal, deep green for high-income OECD economies through red for low-income, a five-step diverging palette in the field's own order.

style-population.title: Population in four classes
style-population.description: POP_EST binned at ten million, fifty million, and two hundred million, light to dark blue, class breaks chosen so the map separates small states from the giants despite the skew.

style-labeled.title: Continents with country names
style-labeled.description: The continent colouring with a NAME label per country.
